description.value:
You no longer read the sky. You argue with it.

  • Trade the Day. During your Night Vigil you may swap today’s aspect with the aspect of any of the next three days in your forecast. The two days exchange aspects; the signs do not move. The day you traded away is still coming. A scheduled Zenith cannot move.
  • Forewarned becomes Foreordained. You and the allies you brief treat a negative aspect as Benefic instead of merely reducing it. Exalted and Benefic days are unchanged.
  • Starless. On a Starless sky you may choose any sign’s Augury as your Augury of the Day.
